evidence.observation: Tube pressure drifting monotonically upward during growth: 2.95 -> 3.16 Torr (k=21..25) at constant Ar 100 sccm
Ar flow steady at setpoint 100 sccm, so rising P is not flow-driven
O2 sensor not installed; atmosphere/air-ingress cannot be verified
Temperature holds 750 °C with normal heater power; thermal control nominal

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or a pump-down/flow-off pressure-rise-of-rate test) to distinguish a seal leak/air ingress from partial exhaust blockage; leak-rate check with Ar off would be decisive.
